verdicts.title: Paused-frozen check fires on restart's timer reset (duplicate of restart-stays-paused)
verdicts.observed: Timer went 299 to 300 on the click:btn-restart tick while paused. This is the restart resetting the level, which the design requires. The real defect is that the game stays in mode 'paused' after restart (see candidate 2).
verdicts.expected: Restart resets the timer to 300 and the game is running again. The frozen-while-paused rule does not apply to a restart.

verdicts.title: Enemy-speed check misfires on restart teleport
verdicts.observed: Enemy e1 jumped from (3,5) to (1,5) on the click:btn-restart tick. Restart resets enemies to their starting positions, so the two-tile jump is expected.
verdicts.expected: Restart puts the whole level back to its starting state, including enemy positions, so this is not a speed violation.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused
verdicts.observed: After pause then click:btn-restart, mode stays 'paused' (not 'playing'). Waiting 30 ticks changes nothing: the timer stays at 300, and no dialog is shown to act on.
verdicts.expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away, so mode should be 'playing' and time should respond to ticks.

verdicts.title: HUD timer shows stale value after resuming
verdicts.observed: After esc then click:btn-resume, state timeLeft is 299 but the HUD reads 'Time 300'.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current timer value, so it should read Time 299.

verdicts.title: Spike hit at score 100 wraps score to 65136, then goes negative
verdicts.observed: At tick 9 a spike hit with score 100 showed score 65136 (an unsigned wrap of 100-500 = -400). A later coin pickup showed score -300, so the score is not clamped at 0 and goes negative.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points, floored at 0. Score is never negative, so the score should be 0 after the spike, and then 100 after the coin.

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter not updated after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After a dash that collects a coin, state coins=1 and the event list includes coin, but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5'.
verdicts.expected: The HUD shows the current coin count as n/5, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Keys reset on restart flagged as key loss without a door
verdicts.observed: Keys drop from 1 to 0 at tick 67, which is the Restart level click (event 'restart'), not a door opening.
verdicts.expected: Restart puts the whole level back to its starting state (section 7), so keys returning to 0 is correct. The check does not exempt restarts, so this is a false positive.

verdicts.title: Key-collected toast covers the pause menu's Resume button
verdicts.observed: At tick 11 the pause menu is open with a 'Key collected' toast visible, and btn-resume reports top=false, so the toast is on top of it and a click on Resume would not reach it.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it (section 7). Resume must receive clicks while the pause menu is open.

verdicts.title: Simultaneous up+right dash moves the player diagonally in one tick
verdicts.observed: Tick 13 with dash-up+dash-right moves the player from (2,8) to (3,7): a diagonal displacement made by two moves in one tick, with only one move allowed.
verdicts.expected: Only the last movement key pressed in a tick counts, so the player makes at most one straight step or dash. Diagonal movement is not allowed.

verdicts.title: Enemy position jump caused by restart, not by enemy movement
verdicts.observed: At tick 38 the enemies jump from e1(5,5)/e2(9,5) to e1(3,5)/e2(9,3) because the token 'enter' restarted the level (event 'restart').
verdicts.expected: Restart resets the level, including enemy starting positions, so the jump is expected. The check does not exempt restarts, so this is a false positive.

verdicts.title: HUD time stays at 300 one tick after the timer has dropped to 299
verdicts.observed: After clicking Resume at tick 1, the state reports timeLeft 299 but the HUD shows 'Time 300', so the displayed value is one tick stale.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current timer value (section 8), so after the tick that drops the timer to 299 it should show 'Time 299'.

verdicts.title: Spike hit wraps score to 65136 and then goes negative
verdicts.observed: At tick 3 a spike hit with score 100 makes the score 65136 (100 minus 500 wraps to 65136 in a 16-bit value). Later the score reads -300 at tick 6, so the score goes out of its valid range.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative and never wraps; spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 (sections 4 and 5). The score should read 0 after the spike, not 65136 or -300.

verdicts.title: Spikes at 100 points wrap score to 65136 instead of flooring at 0
verdicts.observed: At tick 16 the player (score 100, 4 lives? no, 4 lives) hits spikes and the score jumps from 100 to 65136. Later the score falls from 65136 to 2270 at level complete with no spikes or restart event.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so score should be 0 after the spike at tick 16. Score should never drop except by spikes or restart.

verdicts.title: HUD coins stays 0/5 after collecting a coin on a dash
verdicts.observed: After dash-right collects a coin, state reports coins=1 but the HUD shows 'Coins 0/5'.
verdicts.expected: HUD Coins field shows the current count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Keys reset to 0 on restart level (by design)
verdicts.observed: Keys drop from 1 to 0 only because the player chose Restart level from the pause menu, which resets the whole level.
verdicts.expected: Restart level puts the whole level back to its starting state, including keys 0. The check does not exempt restart, so this is a false positive.

verdicts.title: Relic toast covers the Finish button on the level complete dialog
verdicts.observed: On level complete, btn-next (Finish) reports top=false while the 'Relic! +20000' toast is visible, so a click at its centre does not reach the button.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it, so Finish must be the topmost element at its centre.

verdicts.title: HUD time lags one tick behind the timer after resume
verdicts.observed: After click:btn-resume the state shows time 287 but the HUD shows Time 288; the HUD keeps showing the stale value for several ticks.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current timer value (ticks left), matching timeLeft.

verdicts.title: Score goes negative (-300) after spike underflow
verdicts.observed: Spikes at score 65136 (the wrapped value from an earlier spike at low score) leave the score at 65136 and a later coin makes the HUD read Score -300.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999. Spikes should floor the score at 0, so no negative value should appear.

verdicts.title: HUD coins stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: At tick 4 the player steps onto a coin: state coins=1, score=100, and the event list includes coin. The HUD keeps showing 'Coins 0/5' for the rest of the run, even after coins=1 is confirmed in state.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' right after the coin is collected (section 8).

verdicts.title: HUD timer lags one tick behind the real timer after resuming from pause
verdicts.observed: Tick 19 (click:btn-resume) is a running tick: timeLeft drops 283 to 282, but the HUD shows 'Time 283'. The HUD stays one tick behind (ticks 20-23 show 283 while timeLeft is 281, 280, 279). The score and other HUD fields update correctly.
verdicts.expected: The HUD time field shows the current ticks left on the timer, which should be 282 after that tick, matching timeLeft (section 8).

verdicts.title: HUD timer lags one tick behind the real timer after resuming from pause (duplicate of hud-time repro)
verdicts.observed: Same symptom as the previous candidate: the resume tick at #19 drops timeLeft to 282 while the HUD still shows 'Time 283', and the HUD stays stale through the level-complete and victory screens. The trailing 'enter' token is not needed to show the bug, so this repro is not minimal.
verdicts.expected: The HUD time field matches timeLeft on every tick (section 8). The timer should show 282 right after the resume tick.
